data.name: coverage_check
data.description: Find important entities an existing AI research result may have missed and report observable search saturation and known gaps.
limitations: No mathematical completeness claim for open-web research

entries.description: Use when comprehensive entity discovery matters and ordinary web search may have stopped too early.
representativeQueries: What important companies did my research miss?
Check whether this competitor list is missing major players
Find additional suppliers beyond the ones I already found
Is it worth continuing this search for more entities?

metadata.note: GitHub Pages project-site path is used for the first experiment. A custom root domain can be added later for strict domain-anchored discovery.
